title: Antique Brass Wall-Mounted Soap Dish, 4.5-Inch Solid Brass Bathroom Soap Dish, Dottingham, Allied Brass
description:
Stop soggy soap and cluttered sink edges with a wall-mounted soap dish designed to keep bar soap contained and your bathroom countertop clear in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This wall-mounted soap dish (also called a soap holder or soap tray) mounts on the wall for everyday convenience and a coordinated look with transitional bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Clean installation look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Coordinate with the Dottingham collection for matching Dottingham and other beaded bathroom hardware in a cohesive set of transitional bathroom hardware
- Easy setup—installation hardware included; no assembly required

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 3 x 3.5 inches
- Projection: 5 inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Included items: Brass soap dish holder and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
